author: Isabel Martin
title: Man, woman driving stolen car arrested in Laurens: Police - NewsBreak
text:
By Isabel Martin ,
4 hours ago
LAURENS, S.C. (WSPA) — Traffic cameras helped police officers in Laurens arrest a man and woman wanted for multiple charges on Wednesday.
According to the Laurens Police Department, at around 9:35 a.m., officers were alerted via license plate reader (LPR) cameras that a car that was stolen in Myrtle Beach had entered city limits.
Officials said they determined that the driver was also wanted in Myrtle Beach.
The car was pulled over by officers patrolling in the area, police said.
Police arrested the driver, James Anthony Nabors, for receiving stolen goods and a third offense of driving under suspension.
The passenger in the car, Angela Renee Swaney, was wanted for drug offenses in Anderson County. She was taken into custody by Anderson County deputies.
Officials added that the stolen car was recovered.
